name: Correlate the Trace
description:
The affected payment service left application logs. Mixed into ordinary transfers and health checks are the fingerprints of the backdoors in action — an injected probe, a telemetry beacon that balloons, and a day-gated routine that leaks a marker a piece at a time.

Read the log carefully and answer the three questions below.
hints: Everything you need is in the log itself. Compare the odd lines against the many ordinary ones around them, and mind the order timestamps put things in.

questions.prompt: Nearly every connectivity probe in the log reaches the same internal metrics host. Exactly one does not — and it smuggles something past the probe. Submit that probe's full host= value, verbatim.
A scheduled task ships a payload to a fixed destination on a steady cadence, and the payload size climbs run over run. Give the destination host it ships to — hostname only, no scheme or path.

The attacker's tooling leaked a marker one fragment at a time, but only while a day-gated collection routine was actually active. Collect those fragments in timestamp order, reassemble them, and decode the result to recover the marker.
